title: Heavenly Secrets Revealed
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was immersed in the shock brought by his new ability, an urgent transmission exploded in his Mental Sea—Elder Mo Xiansheng's aged and grave voice came through: 'The Eye of Heavenly Dao has locked onto the Forbidden Grounds' coordinates! Retreat immediately!'

text.content: The night wind cut like a blade, slicing through the silence of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Chen Ji stood alone at the Cliff Edge, his palm tightly gripping the Jade Pendant left behind by Chen Nian before her departure. The pendant felt warm, as if still retaining his sister's Body Temperature. He closed his eyes, and the True Qi within his body slowly surged, attempting to activate the dormant power within this bloodline relic. Below the cliff, clouds churned like a sea, and the distant Tianqing Peak loomed indistinct beneath the moonlight, resembling a slumbering giant beast.

The Jade Pendant suddenly emitted a clear, resonant hum. Chen Ji felt a burning sensation in his chest—that was the unique resonance of the Chen family's Bloodline! In his Mental Sea, the yellowed Fragment began turning on its own, golden light patterns spreading along his Meridians, scorching everything they touched like raging flames. Chen Ji clenched his teeth, allowing that power to rampage through his body. This pain, he had long anticipated.

dialogue.content: 'It has arrived...' The remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed from the depths of his Mental Sea, carrying an undeniable excitement, 'The second page's seal is loosening. Quickly, use your Bloodline as the guide!'

text.content: Without hesitation, Chen Ji bit his fingertip, letting a drop of crimson blood fall onto the Jade Pendant. In an instant, heaven and earth lost their colors! The Jade Pendant transformed into a stream of light that vanished into his Brow Center. In his Mental Sea, the Fragment on the page burst open—golden runes surged forth like a tide, weaving into a complex formation diagram in the Void. The second page of the Tianji Record had manifested!

The new Heavenly Secrets power flooded into his mind, and Chen Ji shuddered. His vision suddenly broadened, and the blurred future scenes became crystal clear—everything within the next six hours of cause and effect flow was before his eyes! Yet immediately after, a terrifying sense of weakness surged from the depths of his marrow, as if something had been forcibly extracted.

dialogue.content: 'Six hours of foresight, each use costs one year of lifespan.' Mo Xiansheng's voice turned grave, 'Compared to the consumption of Heavenly Fate Value, this lifespan damage is even more dangerous—if you falter, everything ends.'

text.content: Chen Ji opened his eyes, golden patterns flickering briefly in his pupils. He raised his head toward the Void, and an icy chill ran down his spine—that sensation had returned, the feeling of being observed by some supreme existence. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's pressure bore down like mountains collapsing, a hundred times stronger than ever before!

dialogue.content: In the void, a cold voice reverberated through Chen Ji's Mental Sea: 'The second page... you dared to open the second page.' The voice carried no emotion whatsoever, yet it made Chen Ji's scalp go numb, as if he faced not some consciousness but the judgment of Heavenly Dao itself.

text.content: Chen Ji forced down the agitation in his heart, and instead, a cold smile tugged at his lips. He slowly spoke, his voice soft but each word clear: 'Heavenly Dao operates by its own principles. I am merely seeking a sliver of opportunity within this Chess Game. Since the elder is so wary of me, could it be that you fear this chess piece will turn the board?'

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Dao's pressure crushed down like something tangible. Chen Ji felt unprecedented crisis. At this life-or-death moment, he had to make a choice—

choices.text: Immediately activate the second page ability
choices.description: Use the newly acquired six-hour foresight ability to peer into the solution before the Eye of Heavenly Dao locks onto him. The cost is one year of lifespan, but it might turn the tide.
choices.visible_reward: Six-hour foresight ability activated, can glimpse key future turning points
choices.risk_hint: Lifespan consumption is irreversible, and the Eye of Heavenly Dao may take the opportunity to strike

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer. The golden patterns at his Brow Center suddenly blazed brilliantly! He formed seals with both hands, and the second page of the Tianji Record burst open. The river of cause and effect within six hours surged before his eyes—the scene was so vast it nearly shattered his divine sense!

Intense vertigo struck. Chen Ji felt his lifespan flowing away like a breached dam. Yet in that instant, he saw clearly—three days later at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, an entrance to the Ancient Forbidden Land would appear, and that entrance was right beneath his feet!

choices.text: Retreat and hide, conceal one's aura
choices.description: Conceal all spiritual energy, temporarily refrain from activating the new ability. Using the original concealment art from the Tianji Record Fragment, attempt to evade the Eye of Heavenly Dao's detection, preserving strength for future plans.
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao may have already locked on; one's aura may not be completely hidden

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging power within his body. He silently recited the concealment technique passed down by Mo Xiansheng, his aura dispersing like flowing water, merging with the night. However, that sensation of being watched not only didn't weaken but grew even more intense—the Eye of Heavenly Dao seemed to have seen through everything!

choices.description: Undeterred by pressure, probe the Eye of Heavenly Dao's bottom line with words. Seize this opportunity to gain more information about the truth of the Tianji Record, while buying time for Mo Xiansheng's preparations.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao's fury is beyond human resistance

text.content: Chen Ji surged forward against that world-destroying pressure, saying loudly: 'The elder controls Heavenly Dao and operates cause and effect. Surely you wouldn't lose composure over a mere chess piece's small actions. This junior dares to ask: what taboo has the appearance of this second page touched?'

dialogue.content: Silence. Endless silence. The pressure suddenly receded, and the Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice rang out again, but with a more profound meaning: 'You are quite bold... Interesting. This game of chess, let me see how far you can go.'

text.content: The pressure withdrew, but Chen Ji felt no relief from this near-death experience. He clearly understood that the Eye of Heavenly Dao's words were not goodwill probing but the hunter's delight watching prey struggle. He clenched his fists until his knuckles turned white. This game was far more dangerous than he had imagined.

'Little one, you've gotten yourself into big trouble.' Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded, carrying a hint of helplessness, 'The appearance of the second page has shifted that one's gaze from the entire board to you alone. From now on, every time you use the Heavenly Secrets power, it will be watching.'

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's words were like cold water poured down, making Chen Ji acutely aware of his situation. Under the Eye of Heavenly Dao's observation, he must reassess his methods of obtaining power—

choices.description: Decide not to use the second page ability unless absolutely necessary, only动用第一页的fate消耗 in life-or-death moments. Compress every use of power to the extreme, ensuring every ounce of cost is applied precisely where needed.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon active use of the second page

text.content: 'The elder speaks truly.' Chen Ji said deeply, 'Since the Eye of Heavenly Dao has its eyes on me, I must be even more meticulous with my calculations. This six-hour foresight ability, I will only use at critical turning points. On ordinary days, the first page's three-hour foresight will suffice.'
Upon hearing this, a trace of relief actually appeared in Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul: 'Your clarity is admirable. It seems these years of playing weak have not dulled your edge.'

choices.text: Take the initiative to strike, challenge limits
choices.description: Since you've already been marked, hiding is pointless. Why not go all out? Train furiously under the Eye of Heavenly Dao's gaze, build strength through battle, cut a bloody path through this dead end.
choices.risk_hint: May die from the Eye of Heavenly Dao's backlash

text.content: A wild gleam flickered in Chen Ji's eyes: 'Since it wants to watch, let it watch its fill! My fate I myself will write. The more it fears me, the more I will make it regret not killing me when it had the chance!'

Before his words even finished, he had already crossed his legs and sat down. The second page of the Tianji Record burst open, golden light shooting to the heavens, Spiritual Energy from a hundred li surged in wildly—this was a forbidden technique trading life for power! Mo Xiansheng tried to stop him, but it was already too late.

The moment Chen Ji made his choice, a torrent of profound information burst forth from the second page, forcibly pouring into his Mental Sea. That was detailed data about the Ancient Forbidden Land—entrance locations, opening times, internal structures, guardian formations... everything was clearly marked by the Tianji Record, as if responding to what he had just glimpsed.

'Forbidden Grounds...' Chen Ji murmured, his pupils contracting. He finally understood the meaning of Chen Nian's words before she left—'The answer lies where it all began.' The so-called 'beginning' was actually this Ancient Forbidden Land! The Chen family's secrets were inextricably linked to the Forbidden Grounds!

dialogue.content: 'Little Nian...' Chen Ji said softly, his tone carrying a tenderness he rarely showed, 'How much do you actually know?' He gripped the pendant that had already turned into ordinary jade, his heart acomplex的 mix of emotions. This sister who had been missing for years was far more complicated than he had imagined.

text.content: The howling night wind swept away some of the distractions from Chen Ji's mind. He reopened his eyes, his gaze becoming unprecedentedly resolute. No matter how dangerous the road ahead, he would see it through. So what if there's the Eye of Heavenly Dao? So what if three major Sects clash? So what if the Demonic Path invades? Chen Ji never believed in fate!

choice.prompt: The second page's abilities and costs are now clear, and the Eye of Heavenly Dao's threat hangs over him like a sword. At this moment, Chen Ji must decide his next move—

choices.text: Immediately head to the Forbidden Grounds
choices.description: Taking advantage of the Eye of Heavenly Dao's momentary relaxation of vigilance, rush to scout the Forbidden Grounds immediately. Time is tight; moving earlier might secure the initiative, even if it means risking danger alone.
choices.visible_reward: Scout the Forbidden Grounds' secrets in advance
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao may counterattack at any moment

text.content: Chen Ji's form flashed, transforming into a stream of light hurtling toward the Forbidden Grounds. In the night, his figure moved like a ghost, weaving through mountains and forests. Three hours later, he stood before a majestic peak—the entrance to the Forbidden Grounds lay right at that mist-shrouded summit.

choices.text: First return to the Sect to consolidate intelligence
choices.description: The Forbidden Grounds expedition is fraught with unpredictable dangers; rushing in blindly is no different from seeking death. Better to return to the Tianqing Sect first, use his Inner Sect identity to gather more intelligence about the Forbidden Grounds, while also contacting potential allies.

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed his urgent eagerness, turning back toward his original path. The Forbidden Grounds opens in three days; there was still sufficient time. Better to return to the Sect and make some preparations first. More importantly, he needed to confirm whether Su Qingyao had noticed anything—her intuition was dangerously sharp, and he couldn't afford to let his guard down.

Just as Chen Ji was weighing the pros and cons, a familiar aura suddenly drifted from nearby. His brow furrowed, and he looked toward the source—a white-robed figure stood a hundred zhang away in the night, watching him silently. That cold frost-like face, that noble bearing—if not Su Qingyao, who else could it be?

dialogue.content: 'Traveling alone at night, covered in blood—Chen Ji, you keep giving people pleasant surprises.' Su Qingyao's voice was cold as ice, yet her eyes gleamed with probing curiosity, 'That冲天golden light just now, what exactly was it?'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression remained composed. He leisurely straightened his clothes, revealing a simple, honest smile: 'Senior Sister Su visits this place late at night. Could she be here specifically to find Chen? To be honest, I merely had a sudden enlightenment while cultivating, and the commotion was a bit larger than expected.'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao coldly snorted, stepping closer: 'Sudden enlightenment? Chen Ji, do you take me for a child? That golden light contained power no Servant Disciple could possess. Speak, what exactly are you hiding?'

text.content: Their eyes met. Chen Ji clearly saw the determination in Su Qingyao's gaze. This was his third direct confrontation with her, and the most dangerous one yet. Her intuition had brought her infinitely close to the truth; one more step forward and he might never be able to keep secrets again. Yet just then, something unexpected happened!

dialogue.content: 'The Eye of Heavenly Dao has locked onto the Forbidden Grounds' position! Retreat immediately!' Mo Xiansheng's urgent, aged transmission exploded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. Chen Ji shuddered. At the same time, a blinding white light suddenly blazed across the distant horizon—that was the sign that the Forbidden Grounds' entrance was being forcibly opened!

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. He seized Su Qingyao's wrist, saying gravely: 'There's no time to explain! Someone is opening the Forbidden Grounds, come with me!' Before his words even finished, he was already dragging Su Qingyao in the opposite direction at breakneck speed. Su Qingyao was stunned by his sudden action. She tried to break free instinctively, but found his hand like an iron vice, tightly gripping her pulse gate.

'Chen Ji! You...' Su Qingyao was about to speak when Chen Ji suddenly stopped, turning to look at that white light. His gaze was terrifyingly cold, his lips slightly parting: 'It's too late.' The moment his voice fell, an overwhelming pressure poured forth from that white light, like heaven collapsing and earth shattering, instantly shrouding a hundred li. Chen Ji felt his blood and qi churning violently, and a mouthful of blood nearly burst forth.

That pressure carried a familiar aura—Holy Sect! Chen Ji instantly understood: Chen Nian's mention of 'Holy Sect intervention' meant precisely this. They had known about the Forbidden Grounds' existence all along, and now, taking advantage of his activation of the second page and the Eye of Heavenly Dao's diverted attention, they made their move! This was a two-birds-with-one-stone scheme!

dialogue.content: 'Holy Sect...' Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply, her face instantly ashen, 'How could they appear here?' Though she was Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, she had never faced a true demonic path expert. The intensity of that pressure far exceeded her comprehension.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the churning blood and qi within his body. His gaze was like a hawk's, locked死死on that distant white light. His mind raced at lightning speed, countless thoughts flashing through his head. The Holy Sect's intervention had disrupted his plans, but now was not the time for panic. He slowly spoke, his voice low and composed: 'Senior Sister Su, do you trust me?'

Su Qingyao froze. She looked at this Servant Disciple who was ordinarily meek and cowardly, yet now displayed a bearing she had never witnessed—that was the demeanor of a mastermind, a Chess Player who could decide victories from a command tent. Against her better judgment, she nodded. A meaningful smile curved Chen Ji's lips: 'Then follow me. Tonight's game of chess should teach the Holy Sect what it means to have a flawless strategy.'
